description.value: This Starbucks operates on the first floor of the Fipke Centre at UBC Okanagan, run by UBCO Food Services as part of an 11-location campus dining network. It offers the standard Starbucks lineup of espresso drinks, Teavana teas, Frappuccinos, smoothies, snacks, and pastries. Its campus setting makes it a convenient stop for cyclists touring the University Way corridor in Kelowna.

address.value: Fipke Centre, 3247 University Way, Kelowna, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a Starbucks located within the Fipke Centre on the UBC Okanagan campus at 3247 University Way, Kelowna. The OSM tag 'takeaway=yes' is corroborated by the website's 'Grab a snack on the go' language. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags; the phone number in OSM (+1-250-807-8837) does not appear on the website's contact page, which lists different numbers for UBCO Food Services.
concerns: Phone number in OSM (+1-250-807-8837) does not appear on the UBCO Food Services contact page, which lists 250-807-9208 (general) and 250-807-8050 (meal plans) instead — OSM phone is unconfirmed.
OSM opening_hours tag is invalid (value is ';'). Website indicates weekday-only hours with weekend closure.
Address field is empty in OSM; address sourced from website (Fipke Centre, 3247 University Way).
Campus franchise location — access and hours may vary significantly during university breaks and holidays.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate cafe with food and drink suitable for touring cyclists, but it operates only on weekdays and is located on a university campus with limited seasonal hours; suitability depends on whether the directory intends to include campus-only franchise outlets with restricted operating windows.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website homepage lists multiple campus locations and notes holiday/exam-period closures. Cyclists should verify current operating status before relying on this stop.
